title: Warranty Coverage Visit Crew Table: Technicians Needed by Installation Method
content:
For a technician visit whose trip charge Warranty Coverage bills, the crew a visit needs follows the method of the installation job that installed the covered openings, as recorded on the Installation Jobs records, and sets the crew rate:

| Installation method of the job | Technicians the visit needs | Crew rate |
|---|---|---|
| Bay and Bow Installation | three | 3.0 (three-technician crew rate) |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | two | 2.0 (two-technician crew rate) |
| Masonry Opening Installation | two | 2.0 (two-technician crew rate) |
| any other method | — | no crew rate |

In clause form: a visit to openings whose installation job used the Bay and Bow Installation method needs three technicians and takes the three-technician crew rate; a visit to openings whose installation job used the Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap method or the Masonry Opening Installation method needs two technicians and takes the two-technician crew rate; a visit to openings installed by any other method takes no crew rate.

## Points of judgement

- The job is the installation job recorded on the Warranty Coverage registration — the job whose completion started coverage — and its method is the method on that job's Installation Jobs record.
- Insert Pocket Installation, plain Full-Frame Installation and Door System Installation take no crew rate.
